glance.what: Most AI videos look cheap and people scroll past them. StoryShort writes the script, plans every scene, and keeps your characters and your style the same all the way through. Free to start.

流量渠道全景待补充：需 Similarweb/公开流量估算核实。

近 30 天收入与 MRR 基本持平（0.97 倍），以经常性订阅为主。
按 MRR 年化运行率约 US$268.8K。
具体增长打法待补充：需社媒/目录公开内容核实。
